name: Shelly BLU Motion
summary: Coin-cell Bluetooth PIR motion sensor with lux sensing, 5-year battery, BTHome.

requires: Shelly BLE gateway (Plus/Gen3/Gen4/Pro) or BTHome receiver for automation beyond phone range

extra.kb_mismatch: kb_slug shelly-blu-motion-zb is the BLU Motion ZB (SBMO-103Z, Bluetooth+Zigbee, 3-level lux); listing handle/blurb is the Bluetooth-only BLU Motion. Zigbee radio and ZB-specific features may not apply.

gotchas: Bluetooth-only: automations/remote alerts need a Shelly Plus/Gen3/Gen4/Pro BLE gateway in range (~10 m indoors)
KB data is for the ZB variant — don't assume Zigbee on this Bluetooth-only listing
PIR motion, not presence: still occupants time out — see Shelly Presence Gen4 (mmWave)
CR2477 is a less common coin cell than CR2032
best_for: Hallway/closet motion-triggered lighting with a nearby Shelly relay as gateway
